records.name: Gate B12
records.description: Departure gate B12 serving short-haul international flights. Seating for 120 passengers with charging points.
records.directions: From security control, follow the yellow 'Gates B1-B20' signs, walk 350 m along Pier B. Gate B12 is on the right, about 6 minutes on foot.
records.accessibility: Step-free route via lift L4; wheelchair assistance available on request.

records.name: Gate A3
records.description: Departure gate A3 used mainly for domestic flights, close to the Pier A coffee bar.
records.directions: After security, turn left towards Pier A and walk 150 m; Gate A3 is the third gate on the left, about 3 minutes on foot.
records.accessibility: Fully step-free; hearing loop at the gate desk.

records.name: Terminal 1 Check-in Area
records.description: Main check-in hall with desks 1-40. Desks 30-40 handle international and long-haul airlines; self-service kiosks in the centre.
records.directions: From the main entrance, the check-in hall is straight ahead on Level 1. International desks 30-40 are at the far right end.
records.accessibility: Lowered counters at desks 5 and 35; staff assistance available.

records.name: Baggage Claim Hall
records.description: Arrivals baggage reclaim with belts 1-8. Flight-to-belt allocations are shown on overhead screens.
records.directions: After passport control, take the escalator or lift down one level and follow the 'Baggage Reclaim' signs, about 4 minutes on foot.
records.accessibility: Step-free via lift L1; porter service bookable at the Special Assistance Desk.

records.name: Security Control
records.description: Central security screening for all departing passengers. Liquids up to 100 ml; laptops out of bags. Fast Track lane available.
records.directions: From check-in, take the escalator to Level 2 and follow the 'All Gates / Security' signs. Queue times are shown at the entrance.
records.accessibility: Dedicated assistance lane; private search room on request.

records.name: Information Desk T1
records.description: Staffed information point for flight information, directions, lost property forms, and general help in several languages.
records.directions: In the centre of the Level 1 departures hall, under the large blue 'i' sign, next to the self-service kiosks.
records.accessibility: Lowered counter, hearing loop, staff trained in basic sign language.

records.name: Lost and Found Office
records.description: Office for items lost in the terminal or left on aircraft. Online claim form available; items stored for 90 days.
records.directions: In the arrivals hall on Level 0, to the left of the Baggage Claim exit, next to the car rental counters.

records.name: Skyview Lounge
records.description: Premium lounge with hot food, showers, quiet zone and runway views. Pay-on-entry and priority-pass access.
records.directions: Airside in Terminal 2: after security take lift L7 to Level 3 and follow the 'Lounges' signs, about 5 minutes on foot.
records.accessibility: Step-free via lift L7; accessible shower room available.

records.name: Restaurant Plaza
records.description: Food court with six outlets: coffee, burgers, sushi, pizza, salads and a bakery. Halal and vegan options marked on menus.
records.directions: Immediately after security control, turn right into the Duty Free Mall; the Restaurant Plaza is at its far end, about 3 minutes on foot.
records.accessibility: Step-free throughout; accessible seating at all outlets.

records.name: Restroom Pier B
records.description: Toilets opposite Gate B8, including accessible toilet and baby-changing room.
records.directions: Along Pier B, directly opposite Gate B8, about 2 minutes from the start of the pier.
records.accessibility: Accessible toilet with emergency cord; adult changing bench.

records.name: Airport Train Station
records.description: Rail station with express trains to the city centre every 15 minutes (journey time 22 minutes) and regional services.
records.directions: From the arrivals hall, follow the green 'Trains' signs and take the escalator or lift down two levels, about 6 minutes on foot.
records.accessibility: Lifts to all platforms; staff assistance for boarding via help points.

records.name: Taxi Pickup Zone
records.description: Official licensed taxi rank. Card payment accepted in all vehicles; fixed fares to the city centre displayed at the rank.
records.directions: Exit the arrivals hall through Door 4 and cross the covered walkway; the taxi rank is directly ahead.
records.accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible vehicles available at the front of the rank on request.

records.name: Bus Station
records.description: Local and long-distance coach services, including night buses to the city. Tickets from machines or on board.
records.directions: From Terminal 1 arrivals, exit through Door 6 and follow the covered walkway for 200 m towards Terminal 2.
records.accessibility: Level boarding at all stands; tactile paving throughout.

records.name: Special Assistance Desk
records.description: Meeting point and help desk for passengers with reduced mobility, hidden disabilities, or those travelling with medical equipment.
records.directions: To the left of the main entrance on Level 1, marked with the blue assistance symbol, before the check-in desks.
records.accessibility: This is the accessibility hub: wheelchairs, buggies and trained staff; sunflower lanyards available.

records.name: Prayer Room
records.description: Quiet multi-faith prayer and reflection room with washing facilities, open to all passengers and staff.
records.directions: Take lift L2 from the departures hall to Level 3 and follow the 'Multi-faith Room' signs, about 3 minutes.
records.accessibility: Step-free via lift L2; accessible washing facilities.

records.name: Duty Free Mall
records.description: Main airside shopping area with duty free, pharmacy, electronics and convenience stores.
records.directions: Directly after security control; all passengers pass through the mall on the way to the gates.
records.accessibility: Step-free; wide aisles suitable for wheelchairs and buggies.

records.name: Car Rental Centre
records.description: Counters for six major car rental companies; vehicles collected from the adjacent multi-storey car park.
records.directions: In the arrivals hall, to the right of the exit doors, next to the Lost and Found Office.
records.accessibility: Adapted vehicles available if booked 48 h in advance.

records.name: Medical and First Aid Point
records.description: First aid room staffed by paramedics; defibrillators located throughout the terminal (green AED signs).
records.directions: On Level 1 beside Door 2, behind the Information Desk; in an emergency contact any staff member.
records.accessibility: Step-free access; emergency assistance available anywhere in the terminal.
